mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and other metabolic pathways, potentially reducing furosemide levels; additionally, furosemide-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia may be exacerbated, increasing seizure threshold variability.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly and assess diuretic efficacy; consider adjusting furosemide dose if needed and monitor seizure control during concurrent therapy.
